newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products slip with crude, bar fuel oil.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products slip with crude, bar fuel oil.

text.p: NWE oil products were easier on Wednesday bar fuel oil, traders said.
Gas oil fell $1.75 a tonne with futures but spreads were steady. Low sulphur diesel was done at July IPE +$6.50.

High sulphur fuel barges were steady at the upper end of the last two day's trading range at $85 fob ARA but traders said the high numbers were not backed by good demand. Low slphur barges were quietly talked $95/97.
Gasoline was steady to about $1 weaker as screen crude slipped and yesterday's sharp $3 hike was pondered in the sober light of this morning.-- London newsroom +44 171 542 7646 For
